ValidationRule.description: When product is inactive, product can not be updated.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT ( IsActive ) && ( ISCHANGED( Name ) || ISCHANGED( Family ) || ISCHANGED( Service_Type__c ) || ISCHANGED( Description ) || ISCHANGED( Effective_year__c ) || ISCHANGED( Effective_Start_Date__c ) || ISCHANGED( Effective_End_Date__c ) || ISCHANGED( Intervention_Code_CCI__c ) || ISCHANGED( CCI_Level__c ) || ISCHANGED( Cost__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fields cannot be edited on a deactivated product. Activate the product to make changes.
